artworks.title: Nude Female Figure [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white chalk
artworks.description: The image is a pencil and chalk drawing of a seated nude figure in a side profile. The individual is seated on a draped fabric or cushion, with one knee bent. The figure's head is turned away from the viewer, appearing to hold or adjust a piece of fabric or towel on their head. The person's long hair flows down the back. The detailed drawing captures the curves and lines of the human form. The backdrop is simple, with textured lines suggesting drapery or movement for added depth.

artworks.title: Nude Figure (academic study)
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person seen from the back. The person is seated, with a slightly twisted torso, a bent right leg, and their left arm extended upward, holding onto ropes or cords. The person has long, flowing hair with loose strands. They are unclothed, with no visible jewelry or objects, set against a background of crosshatched lines.

artworks.title: Saint Barbara in Glory with Saints Nicholas and Jerome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash heightened with white on handmade rag paper
artworks.description: The image features three human figures and several cherubs in a classical artwork style. The upper portion shows a person depicted from the waist up, positioned within the clouds, their head slightly tilted upward, and one arm slightly raised while holding a palm frond. This person's facial features are delicate, with curly hair and a calm expression, adorned with a flowing robe. Accompanying this figure are several winged cherubs, one of whom appears to be holding a tower-like structure. The lower half of the image presents two additional standing figures on either side of a large, wheel-like symbol. Both are dressed in long, flowing garments, and one figure holds a crook-like staff. Their faces are less detailed, adding a sense of abstraction to their forms. The background displays a lively sky filled with swirling clouds, creating a dramatic and ethereal setting. The entire scene is composed with a sepia-toned palette, giving it an aged and classical appearance.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome (?)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and peach wash squared with black chalk
artworks.description: The image features several human figures depicted in a sketch-like style with light red and brown tones. In the foreground, an older seated man with a long beard leans on his right hand, looking upward towards another figure. Beside him sits a lion with its mouth slightly open. A winged figure stands to the left offering a crown to the seated man. In the upper section, a divine figure seated upon clouds extends their arms outward. This figure is surrounded by four other smaller figures sitting on clouds, engaged with each other. The background suggests an ethereal, cloudy environment.

artworks.title: The Deluge, from the Loggia of the Vatican
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring mythological figures and animals. The drawing depicts a collection of nude figures interacting in a landscape setting. In the central foreground, two muscular figures seem engaged in a dynamic posture. Surrounding these figures, there are more characters in various poses. On the left, a figure appears crouched down beside a large animal, possibly a horse, and is looking toward the central figures. The background features undulating lines suggesting hills or clouds, and a few structures resembling ancient architecture. The scene is rendered in delicate lines, providing a sense of movement and flow across the composition.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash on laidpaper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with figures. The scene shows a group of individuals within a grand classical architectural setting characterized by tall columns and a large, ornate doorway. The figures are dressed in traditional, flowing robes. The background architecture includes intricate details like pilasters and a circular window above the door. The floor is a checkered pattern. The drawing uses sepia tones and a composition style reminiscent of European Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Two Nudes
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a study of two male figures showing their back and waist up, focusing on the muscular anatomy. Both figures have broad shoulders and defined muscular backs, with detailed attention given to the curvature and tension of the muscles. They are in seated positions, slightly turned to the side. The drawing does not show their heads in full detail, but some facial features such as the outline of the jaw and part of the ear can be seen. The hair is suggested by flowing lines. The sketch is rendered in a reddish-brown medium on a textured, light background, possibly paper. The background is plain, and there are visible stains and marks on the paper.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure and animals in a woodland. The figure is in a composed pose surrounded by foliage and bark textures. The animals are near the figure in a peaceful setting. A hut is included in the scene, along with trees, light and shadow, and distant mountains. The drawing is done in ink.

artworks.title: Nine Figures
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash heightened with white on green prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of intertwined figures. The work depicts a chaotic tangle of human forms, showing muscular figures in various poses—some reaching upward with outstretched arms, others appearing to engage in an emotional struggle. The use of dark shading and highlights on the bodies create a sense of depth and movement, emphasizing the tension within the scene. Colored in pale green with touches of white, the background shows architectural elements, including arches.

artworks.title: Birth Scene
artworks.medium: brush and brown and blue ink with black chalk, heightened with white opaque watercolor, on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a group of figures gathered around a scene. The image shows a tent with an interior scene where a reclining figure is attended to by others. Outside the tent, various figures in flowing robes stand in groups, with some gesturing or holding objects. There is a sense of movement and interaction among the figures, suggesting a narrative or event unfolding. The drawing utilizes a combination of linework and shading to convey depth and emotion, evoking a composition reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque styles.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Neptune
artworks.medium: black crayon with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene at sea. The image depicts several figures in water, surrounding a central figure who holds a trident. There are horses emerging from the water, and a chariot-like structure is implied. Surrounding the main scene, other figures appear to be engaging in acts such as blowing a conch shell, and there are figures in the sky resembling cherubs or putti. The use of shading and the blue-gray background adds a sense of motion to the waves and clouds.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saints John and Joseph [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts four figures: an adult with smooth flowing hair, two children - one lying in the adult's lap with curly hair and the other standing nearby with curly hair, and another adult reclining on a surface with curly hair. The adults have calm expressions and the background is minimally detailed. The sketch uses a single color pencil and focuses on line and form rather than detailed textures or shading.

artworks.title: Joseph and His Brother in Egypt [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene with architectural elements and figures engaged in dynamic interaction. The composition features numerous figures gathered around a central figure wearing a crown. The figures are depicted in various poses that imply movement and interaction, with some appearing in gestures of supplication, conversation, or presentation. The background includes architectural elements such as arches, pillars, and buildings. The use of delicate ink and wash emphasizes the details in the faces and garments of the figures.

artworks.title: The Entry of Saint Antoninus into Florence
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial gathering or procession. The image depicts several figures gathered. At the center, an ornate canopy is held by attendants. The background comprises a large architectural structure, with people seated or standing in a tiered arrangement. The composition is arranged in a semi-circular format, with a variety of postures indicating movement and interaction among the figures. The drawing utilizes a limited color palette, with brown tones dominating the scene. The intricate detailing of the robes and architectural elements suggests a meticulous approach to the depiction of each element within the image.

artworks.title: The Sign of the White Horse, Parson's Green
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12 × 8 cm (4 3/4 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level perspective view of a busy street scene. A row of townhouses with chimneys is visible on the horizon. Large trees frame the scene on the left and right. The artwork features detailed etching with a textured feel to the foliage. The color palette is monochrome with brown and dark tones. A path leads into the scene with figures walking along the street. More buildings and street details are seen in the distance beneath the tree canopy.

artworks.title: Pierrot en Pied, Portrait of the Lady A.C.
artworks.medium: etching in red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 25 × 19 cm (9 13/16 × 7 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slight forward lean, feet together, hands at their sides. The facial features include rounded eyes and a subtle smile, with hair under a hat with a feather. The individual wears a tailored outfit with a ruffled collar, prominent buttons, loose pants, and ruffled sleeves. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure. The sketch is monochromatic with faint lines indicating details.

artworks.title: The Agony of Flowers (L’Agonie des Fleurs)
artworks.medium: color softground etching, etching, and aquatint with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a ceramic vase with intricate designs, holding a variety of colorful flowers. The arrangement consists of red, pink, white, and green blooms. The vase is placed on a colorful surface with a dark background. Leaves extend towards the left, and the flowers curve upwards and to the right.

artworks.title: Limehouse
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a riverside scene near a port or dock with industrial or shipping buildings and tall sailing ships. The horizon is low, with tall ship masts dominating the view. The artwork features sketchy brushstrokes, blending sky, water, and architecture. The color palette is monochromatic in various shades of gray and brown, creating a muted atmosphere. A barge or flatboat is seen on the water with ambiguous figures nearby. Gray clouds fill the sky in the background.

artworks.title: Sir George Calvert, Lord Baltimore
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a portrait of a man identified as Sir George Calvert, Lord Baltimore. The man is facing slightly to the right with a direct gaze. He has a well-defined mustache and small pointed beard, with neatly combed medium-length hair. He is dressed in a dark garment with a detailed white lace ruff collar encircling his neck, typical of 17th-century fashion. The portrait is framed within an oval line drawing and includes his signature, seal, and printed name and title below. The background of the etching is plain.

artworks.title: James McNeil Whistler
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a man with a bushy mustache, a goatee, nearly closed eyes, curly hair, and wearing a dark garment. He has a monocle in his right eye. The background has a cross-hatched pattern. An inscription at the bottom states "First proof printed for Walter Dowdeswell, Mortimer Menpes."

artworks.title: Hans Sebald Beham
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man, primarily focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is depicted in a frontal position with his head turned slightly to one side. He has a full, curly beard and mustache, with hair that appears thick and curly, spreading out from under a soft, rounded hat with fabric folds. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a wise expression. He is wearing a garment with a broad, dark collar that suggests a cloak or robe. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held by the man. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, with some text below the portrait that reads "HANS SEBALD BOEHM" followed by "Beham."

artworks.title: Forsmarck
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image is a detailed line drawing of a pastoral scene with a wide perspective. The scene includes a house, trees, figures in period clothing, a dog, a horse-drawn carriage, grazing animals, and people engaged in various activities. The drawing is done in delicate, fine line work on off-white paper, creating a monochrome effect that emphasizes form and detail. The composition also includes trees and distant architecture, enhancing the pastoral tranquility of the scene.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Animals
artworks.medium: woodcut in silver on lavender paper [restrike]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals arranged in a grid. The artwork features twenty-four unique animals, each sitting within their own rectangular section outlined in white against a muted purple background. Each animal is drawn with a bold style, almost like a woodcut, giving them a quaint and stylized appearance. The animals include lions, elephants, camels, and other creatures, each depicted with minimal details and a focus on simpler forms. The overall layout suggests a catalog or educational chart displaying different animal species. Each section contains the animal along with some simple natural elements like flora or a landscape. The line work and stylistic choices evoke a sense of vintage or folk art aesthetics. At the bottom of the image, the words "MAISCH © NURNBERG" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Endpaper with Animals
artworks.medium: woodcut in gold on light blue paper [restrike]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals arranged in a grid. The image features animals depicted in a simplistic, stylized manner within distinct rectangular panels, creating a gridded appearance. Each animal is shown in a profile view with minimalistic foliage around them. The animals include lions, tigers, elephants, camels, and other creatures, rendered with minimal detail but enough for recognition. The color palette includes strong orange for the animals against a pale blue-green background, creating a contrasting effect. The artwork is signed "IMAISCH" at the bottom, suggesting its origin from "NURNBERG." The style of rendering emphasizes clear outlines and a flat, decorative quality reminiscent of old block prints or stencil art.
